speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are pregnant and experiencing fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise; to begin my assessment, how many weeks pregnant are you and when did these symptoms start?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you. The sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise at 30 weeks gestation is concerning. You mentioned eating ice cream three days prior; did you consume unpasteurized milk products, and do you have a known tick bite or recent travel? Also, have you had any rash, stiff neck, or sensitivity to light?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever. I also have Headache, Anorexia, Fatigue, Malaise.

speaker: Doctor
text: REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count (CBC) and C-Reactive Protein (CRP). REQUEST IMAGES: Blood_Culture. Did you experience any chills or muscle aches alongside your fever, and has your urine output changed?

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeria monocytogenes infection (Listeriosis).

The blood culture results showing Gram-positive rods with tumbling motility are pathognomonic for *Listeria*. Given your 30-week gestation and recent consumption of dairy products, this is a medical emergency. Are you currently experiencing any right upper quadrant pain or jaundice?
